reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage keeps the allowed record window, maps only exact need text matches to capability IDs, and emits unsupported sentinels for needs without matching capabilities. The supplied final coverage preserves all eight records and correctly leaves n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported while marking the six exact capability matches direct.

prioritize_needs contains a behaviorally significant inversion: it computes unsupported as coverage == 'direct'. This ranks covered needs before truly unsupported needs and labels direct coverage rows as unsupported=true while the actual unsupported rows n06-r01 and n06-r07 become unsupported=false. That contradicts the unit role requiring unsupported needs before covered needs using upstream rank within each group.

synthesize_recommendation follows its declared behavior: it retains the eight-item priority window and constructs the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record. The visible bad recommendation is downstream of the inverted unsupported flag and ordering produced by prioritize_needs, not localized to this unit.
